targets.expr: wnc_ap_channel_utilization_ratio * on(mac, radio) group_left(name, band) (max by(mac, radio, name, band) (wnc_ap_info) and on(name, band) label_replace(max by(ap, band) (wnc_client_info{mac="$mac"}), "name", "$1", "ap", "(.*)"))

(wnc_ap_clients * on(mac, radio) group_left(name, band) (max by(mac, radio, name, band) (wnc_ap_info) and on(name, band) label_replace(max by(ap, band) (wnc_client_info{mac="$mac"}), "name", "$1", "ap", "(.*)"))) - 1
wnc_client_protocol{mac="$mac"} * on(mac) group_left(band) max by (mac, band) (wnc_client_info)
wnc_client_power_save_state{mac="$mac"} * on(mac) group_left(name) max by (mac, name) (wnc_client_info)
wnc_client_state{mac="$mac"} * on(mac) group_left(name, ap, wlan) max by (mac, name, ap, wlan) (wnc_client_info)
(wnc_client_state_transition_seconds{mac="$mac"} != wnc_client_state_transition_seconds{mac="$mac"} offset $rollup_interval) * on(mac) group_left(name) max by (mac, name) (wnc_client_info)
